content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) Level 1 Coaching Certificate; Experience of playing A-Division matches organized by Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA); 5 years of experience as a coach of a team affiliated with Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) Experience: 5 years of coaching experience Other conditions: Coach must be present for practice sessions and matches Must be present to provide treatment if an injury occurs during practice or matches Prior written permission is required to attend other cricket tournaments Must wear provided uniform (shoes, t-shirt, pant kit bag, tracksuit) and use sports equipment only during TMC matches

content_sections.heading: TMC Cricket Coach Job Description
content_sections.text: To remain present at all scheduled practice sessions and ensure players receive optimal training. To attend the team during injuries sustained by players during practice or matches and be present for treatment. To address any complaints regarding the coach received from players by conducting proper verification and taking appropriate decisions. To take responsibility for making selected players of the TMC cricket team and permanent TMC players available for daily practice. To obtain prior written permission from the Sports Officer to attend other cricket tournaments.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is purely on a contract basis for 11 months No claim for permanent absorption in service

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Cricket Coach.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (PDF Pages 3-5) and send it to Sports Officer, Dadaji Konddev Stadium, Jawahar Bag Fire Brigade Road, Thane (W), by in person or post, to reach by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MCA Level 1 Coaching Certificate, experience in A-Division matches, and 5 years experience as a coach for affiliated teams.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Coach must be present for practice sessions and matches. Must be present to provide treatment if an injury occurs during practice or matches. Prior written permission is required to attend other cricket tournaments. Must wear provided uniform (shoes, t-shirt, pant kit bag, tracksuit) and use sports equipment only during TMC matches.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Appointment by competent authority.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is purely on a contract basis for 11 months. No claim for permanent absorption in service.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Thane.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of merit certificates; MCA Level 1 passing certificate; Experience certificates.
